# uzbekify

> Uzbek naturalness for AI agents: one skill + CLI (uzpro) + MCP server that
> makes AI-written Uzbek sound like a real person wrote it. Successor to
> uzbek-humanizer. Fully offline, no API keys.

## Install

npm install -g uzbekify      (auto-wires detected agents; or run: uzbekify init)
npx uzbekify init            (alternative: explicit, idempotent, --all/--dry-run)

## CLI (bins: uzbekify, uzpro, uzpro-mcp)

uzpro humanize <file|->   deterministic fixes + diff + ordered agent checklist
uzpro lint <file|dir|->   [--format text|json|sarif] [--fix] [--register R] [--i18n]
uzpro score <file|->      0-100 naturalness + human-voice bonus; --min 90 gate
uzpro translit <file>     Cyrillic<->Latin (ts/ция/ye/ъ/ь/ў/қ/ғ/ҳ hard cases)
uzpro init                install into Claude Code/Cursor/Codex/Windsurf/Gemini/Copilot

Exit codes: 0 clean · 1 findings · 2 usage. JSON schemas in schemas/.

## MCP tools (stdio)

uz_lint, uz_rewrite_plan (ladder + spans), uz_score, uz_translit,
uz_glossary_lookup, uz_calque_check, uz_synonym_suggest (corpus-ranked).

## Agent loop

draft -> uz_score -> fix top deductions (errors first) -> repeat until >= 90.

## Skill

skills/uzbekify/SKILL.md — decision table routes each task to its register,
playbook and command. References and playbooks live beside it.
